text: {"rules":[{"id":"CRC-SCREEN-50-75","version":"2021","title":"Colorectal cancer screening, adults aged 50 to 75 years","source_quote":"The USPSTF recommends screening for colorectal cancer in all adults aged 50 to 75 years.","grade":"A","effective_date":"2021","action":"Screen for colorectal cancer using one of the listed methods at its stated interval.","denominator":"{\"age\": {\"min\": 50, \"max\": 75, \"at\": \"end\"}, \"quote\": \"Adults aged 50 to 75 years\", \"note\": \"Age is evaluated at the end of the measurement year. This is an implementation choice; the text does not specify it.\"}","numerator":"{\"any\": [{\"procedure\": {\"concept\": \"fobt\", \"window\": [\"{MY}-01-01\", \"{MY}-12-31\"]}, \"quote\": \"Every year\", \"note\": \"High-sensitivity gFOBT or FIT rows, frequency every year\"}, {\"procedure\": {\"concept\": \"fit_dna\", \"window\": [\"{MY-2}-01-01\", \"{MY}-12-31\"]}, \"quote\": \"Every 1 to 3 c y\", \"derived\": {\"window\": \"The longest stated sDNA-FIT interval is 3 y, so the window is the measurement year plus the 2 prior years ({MY-2}).\"}}, {\"procedure\": {\"concept\": \"colonoscopy\", \"window\": [\"{MY-9}-01-01\", \"{MY}-12-31\"]}, \"quote\": \"Every 10 y\", \"derived\": {\"window\": \"Every 10 y means the measurement year plus the 9 prior years ({MY-9}).\"}}, {\"procedure\": {\"concept\": \"ct_colonography\", \"window\": [\"{MY-4}-01-01\", \"{MY}-12-31\"]}, \"quote\": \"Every 5 y\", \"derived\": {\"window\": \"Every 5 y means the measurement year plus the 4 prior years ({MY-4}).\"}}, {\"procedure\": {\"concept\": \"flexible_sigmoidoscopy\", \"window\": [\"{MY-4}-01-01\", \"{MY}-12-31\"]}, \"quote\": \"Every 5 y\", \"derived\": {\"window\": \"Every 5 y means the measurement year plus the 4 prior years ({MY-4}).\"}}, {\"all\": [{\"procedure\": {\"concept\": \"flexible_sigmoidoscopy\", \"window\": [\"{MY-9}-01-01\", \"{MY}-12-31\"]}, \"quote\": \"Flexible sigmoidoscopy every 10 y\", \"derived\": {\"window\": \"Every 10 y means the measurement year plus the 9 prior years ({MY-9}).\"}}, {\"procedure\": {\"concept\": \"fobt\", \"window\": [\"{MY}-01-01\", \"{MY}-12-31\"]}, \"quote\": \"FIT every year\"}], \"quote\": \"Flexible sigmoidoscopy with FIT\"}], \"quote\": \"screening for colorectal cancer\"}","exclusions":"[]"}],"coverage_notes":["Version and effective_date are taken from the document id (uspstf_crc_2021). The section text gives no DATE field.","Footnotes a, b and c on the screening methods table are referenced but not included in the section text, so any conditions they carry are not represented.","sDNA-FIT is listed as 'Every 1 to 3 c y'. The rule uses the 3-year outer bound. The text notes that modeling favors every 1 or 2 y and that every 3 y is not efficient, and footnote c is unavailable. Human review is needed on the interval.","The 'fobt' concept covers both high-sensitivity gFOBT and FIT. The guideline's preference for high-sensitivity gFOBT over older versions (eg, Hemoccult II) cannot be distinguished with this concept.","The 'Flexible sigmoidoscopy with FIT' branch is logically subsumed by the annual fobt branch. It is kept only for fidelity to the table.","No exclusions are stated in this section, such as prior colorectal cancer, total colectomy, hospice or limited life expectancy. None were added.","Follow-up colonoscopy after abnormal stool-based, CT colonography or sigmoidoscopy results is not represented.","The practice-consideration details in the 'Practice Considerations' section and Table 1 are not in this section and are not represented. These include adherence, dietary restrictions, bowel preparation and test availability.","Other age groups, such as 45-49 (grade B) and 76-85 (grade C, individualized), are not in this section and are not represented here.","CT colonography extracolonic findings and their evaluation are not represented."]}
